title: Jagged Peppery Korean Chicken Tteok
description: A spicy and crunchy Korean dish featuring chicken stock and soffritto base, made into a tteok form, inspired by the Jeolla region. It is a satvik friendly and adventurous meal option.
instructions: Grind the rice flour into a fine powder using a blender or food processor.
Heat the sesame oil in a large pan over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the korean chili flakes to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken breast to the pan and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Add the chicken stock to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes.
Mix the ground rice flour with the salt and black pepper in a large bowl.
Gradually add the simmered mixture to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and pliable.
Shape the dough into small tteok forms and serve hot.
